name: Palladous-Tor
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past frozen methane lakes, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
the ancient alien ruins still shows toolmarks half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
